component.name: Legato
component.summary: Play the music on your Navidrome or OpenSubsonic server

description.p: Legato is a simple music player for Navidrome and other OpenSubsonic servers, with smooth mixing between songs. Large covers, a floating player bar and few settings.

ul.li: Albums, artists, songs, playlists and favorites from your server
Automatic mixing between songs, and albums without gaps
Instant Mix from any artist, album or song
Synced lyrics from the server, or from LRCLIB if you allow it
Your queue saved on the server and picked up where you left it
A search palette and full keyboard control
Media keys and the desktop's player controls
Several servers, with passwords in the system keychain
Lower memory and CPU use during playback
Disk caches stay under 512 MB
A log file, opened from Settings
Fixes: no more clipping in Automatic crossfade, a song chosen in the search plays, the song length stays right after a gapless change, covers that failed to load come again, tooltips show at once
Create, edit and delete playlists
Search in the header, with the songs of the page you are on first
Recently played on Home, play counts on album pages, genres and plays in Get Info, Appears On for artists
Glass menus, a Transparency setting and a darker background
Automatic crossfade by default
In a narrow window the sidebar opens over the content
Opening the queue no longer freezes the app after browsing for a while, and memory stays flat in long sessions
Home opens faster
Fixes: Esc leaves the full-screen player, the window moves only from empty background, cover colors keep text readable, the player bar's glass blurs what is under it
Home, Recently Added, Albums, Artists, Songs, Favorites and Playlists pages
Gapless playback, Fixed and Automatic crossfade
Instant Mix, lyrics with an optional LRCLIB fallback, Get Info and Find in page
Queue saved on the server and restored at start
Search palette, keyboard shortcuts, media keys and MPRIS
Several servers, passwords in the system keychain
